note: MCP_JSON_LIMIT is pinned small so the oversize boundary is exercised in milliseconds. The production default is mcpJsonLimitFor(MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES) = MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES*6 + 256KB; this case freezes the 413 envelope and the auth-before-buffering ordering, not the default byte count.

steps.name: unauthenticated oversize body is rejected 401 by the key gate BEFORE the parser buffers it
authorized oversize body returns 413 at the buffering boundary
